name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 38 - Am 54
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 38a. Points out that, at the end of 2024, around 20 million children were at risk of poverty or social exclusion, which is roughly one quarter of all children in the EU; believes, therefore, that the EU’s budget needs to step up efforts to combat poverty among children, including migrant children, children with disabilities and children living in precarious family situations, in accordance with the European Child Guarantee; reiterates its previous calls for the ESF+ financial envelope to include a specific and significant budget for fighting child poverty of at least 20 billion euros;
